cards.flavor: Turns back time, resetting the strengths of creatures in the affected area to their original values.

cards.name: Tough Song
cards.abilityText: Protection: HP+20 for 4 rounds.
cards.flavor: All who hear this bracing melody are blessed with increased endurance.
cards.explanation: Protection = Affects target Cepter's creatures during battle.

cards.name: Trade
cards.abilityText: User chooses and exchanges equal-level territories owned by user and target enemy Cepter.
cards.flavor: Compensates the enemy fairly for the land they've been forced to fork over to the user.

cards.name: Trespass
cards.abilityText: For two rounds caster gains the other Cepters' castle bonus.
cards.flavor: Allows a Cepter to ride on the coattails of others as they arrive at the castle and enjoy the same increase in magic power.

cards.name: Triumph
cards.abilityText: User's next lap bonus is increased to 1.5x. Effect ends when user reaches the castle.
cards.flavor: Bestows the favor of the gods upon Cepters as they return from the rages of battle.

cards.name: Upheaval
cards.abilityText: Transforms target territory into a land.
cards.flavor: Converts the target land into a smoldering volcano by calling forth magma to form rocky prominences.

cards.name: Venomous Boil
cards.abilityText: Deals 30 damage to target or creature.
cards.flavor: Summons a cloud of superheated toxic gas, dealing massive damage to water and air creatures.

cards.name: Wall Transform
cards.abilityText: Transforms target creature into a predetermined Defensive creature of the same element.
cards.flavor: Motivates the elemental power within a creature to go berserk, changing it into an embodiment of that element.
cards.explanation: Defensive creature transformed into is determined by element: = Wonder Wall, = Creeping Flame, = Wall of Ice, = Wall of Stone, = Tornado.

cards.name: Waste
cards.abilityText: Target enemy Cepter's creature and item cards cost double magic until target reaches the castle.
cards.flavor: Causes the target's magic to fly out of control, forcing them to devote more than usually necessary into each card.

cards.name: Weathering
cards.abilityText: Transforms target territory into a land.
cards.flavor: Converts the target land into a breezy plain by eroding away any obstacle to the wind's wanderings.

cards.name: Wild Growth
cards.abilityText: Transforms target territory into a land.
cards.flavor: Converts the target land into a verdant forest by covering it in swiftly growing foliage.

cards.name: Wind of Hope
cards.abilityText: User draws 2 cards from their book.
cards.flavor: Summons a familiar of Culdra, goddess of time, to bestow a temporary blessing of cards upon the user.

cards.name: Word of Recall
cards.abilityText: Transports target Cepter straight to castle. User cannot roll the die this turn.
cards.flavor: Calling forth a clear mental image of the castle is critical when reciting this incantation.

cards.name: Zap
cards.abilityText: Deals 10 damage to target creature. / Doublecast
cards.flavor: Though the damage this incantation causes is minor, it can act as a final blow to end a foe's life.
cards.explanation: Doublecast = User is able to use another spell card after using this spell.

cards.name: Zeromn
cards.abilityText: User chooses 1 effect among 7 possible choices.
cards.flavor: The will of Zeromn, creator of the world of Earthgard. Guides users on the path of kings through a host of challenges. Last Updated on Monday, 08 September 2025 13:24
